reason: This PR adds new SQL surface and execution/planning behavior around `EXPLAIN EXPLORE ANALYZE`, and it touches core parser, planner, executor, and statement-context paths. Even if scoped to offline plan exploration, changes in `parser.y`, `optimize.go`, `common_plans.go`, `adapter.go`, and `stmtctx.go` are central enough to risk planner semantics, EXPLAIN/ANALYZE correctness, and statement execution behavior beyond a local fix.
